title: Hunts FH-029: Implement invite acceptance and withdrawal

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 3, Collective. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Scope to named Space steward, pin terms and guard publish/claim with live partner state. Done when: Forwarded invite does not confer rights. Withdrawn venue blocks new proof and preserves historic credit. Requires: FH-008, FH-013, FH-028. Owner role: Web and database.
